self.text: Hey there! I’m Ace, a mid‑30s Korean history buff who’s currently diving into programming. I love working in quiet, focused environments—I need complete silence to get my code right. I’m great at studying independently, but I also enjoy having a study buddy right beside me for those side‑by‑side sessions. I can meet up in person or hop online, whichever suits you. My free slots are Saturday mornings or Sunday afternoons, so feel free to pick a time that works. When I’m not coding, I’m probably in the kitchen experimenting with sourdough—there’s something so satisfying about watching a loaf rise. Looking forward to connecting and sharing some quiet study vibes!
